title: Google models can't "see" images returned from tool calls

linked_prs.title: fix(provider/google): Handling of Image data from the tool call results.
linked_prs.body:
## Background
Gemini was not able to identify images returned from the tool calls.

## Summary
Added handling of image data type from the tool call results.

## Manual Verification
Added an example in generate-text to let the llm see image via tool call.

- [x] Tests have been added / updated (for bug fixes / features)

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

This issue involves tool invocation (a tool returning an image), LLM provider integration (Google Gemini vs. Anthropic/Claude), and model output handling. The failure is specific to agent workflows that process tool outputs for LLMs, fitting the agent issue taxonomy under tool-related and LLM operation issues.
